node: Transformers, dry-type transformers, magnetics, power conditioning, and medium-voltage distribution equipment
summary: Layer 1B expanded the transformer/power-distribution/magnetics node with a two-lane lens. Reference/context exposure is represented by Hammond Power Solutions because it is a relatively pure transformer/magnetics comp with public OTC access in the U.S. Underfollowed discovery candidates include Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and custom power-distribution systems, Preformed Line Products for adjacent transmission hardware that may benefit from the same grid interconnection chokepoint, and Pioneer Power Solutions as a micro-cap speculative exception with direct transformer/switchgear exposure. The common bottleneck logic is that AI data centers, industrial electrification, EV infrastructure, renewables, and grid upgrades all require long-lead, qualified electrical equipment rather than only generation capacity.
